extraction.Name: Mary Laura Huggins
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded September 24, 1919 by the First Nation Bank
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged in favor of Alla Smith for $2500, dated February 21, 1920; mortgage assigned to Rock Island Saving Bank of Gregory, S.D.; in 1926 the Sheriff sold the land to Rock Island Saving Bank for $3881.32 under foreclosure proceedings; on April 10, 1927, the Sheriff conveyed the land by deed to Rock Island Saving Bank
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612450 issued December 21, 1917. The receipt for the patent was signed by the allottee February 1918. Land described as Southwest quarter section 3, township 95, north of range 70. Allottee also known as Laura Zacharias (formerly Mary Laura Huggins); married George Zacharias. Mortgage dated February 21, 1920, by Mary Laura Zacharias.
